scope: RFC 1035 message from local bytes: header flags, questions and CNAME/A/AAAA/MX answers with compressed names
family: c-ares DNS record parser (src/lib/record/ares_dns_parse.c, ares_dns_name.c over ares_buf.c)

name: knot
license_evidence: COPYING and the SPDX header of src/libknot/packet/pkt.c in the release tarball (sha256 2916ac11...), checked in the image
input_api: knot_pkt_t *knot_pkt_new(void *wire, uint16_t len, knot_mm_t *mm) + int knot_pkt_parse(knot_pkt_t *pkt, unsigned flags)
documentation_note: libknot's public header src/libknot/packet/pkt.h (installed by libknot-dev) documents knot_pkt_new (a packet over existing wire data when wire is non-NULL), knot_pkt_parse and the section/rrset getters; rrset-dump.h documents knot_rrset_txt_dump_data.
scope: RFC 1035 message from local bytes: header flags, questions and CNAME/A/AAAA/MX answers with compressed names
family: Knot DNS libknot (packet/pkt.c, packet/rrset-wire.c, dname.c; rrset-dump.c for presentation)
family_note: Own C decoder of the Knot DNS authoritative server, shipped as the libknot library (Debian source knot, binary libknot-dev). Only libknot is built (no daemon, utilities or modules); presentation text comes from knot_rrset_txt_dump_data, lower-cased by the harness. libknot exposes the reserved Z bit, AD and CD separately, so z carries all three.
